<?php
enum ImmediateInt: int { case One = 1; }
enum ImmediatePure { case A; }

echo is_callable('ImmediateInt::from') ? 'string|' : 'BAD|';
echo is_callable([ImmediateInt::class, 'tryFrom']) ? 'class-array|' : 'BAD|';
echo is_callable([ImmediateInt::One, 'from']) ? 'case-array|' : 'BAD|';
echo is_callable('ImmediatePure::cases') ? 'pure-cases|' : 'BAD|';
echo is_callable('ImmediatePure::from') ? 'BAD|' : 'pure-no-from|';
echo is_callable('ImmediatePure::from', true) ? 'pure-syntax|' : 'BAD|';
echo is_callable([ImmediateInt::One, 'missing']) ? 'BAD|' : 'case-no-method|';
echo is_callable([ImmediateInt::One, 'missing'], true) ? 'case-syntax|' : 'BAD|';
echo ImmediateInt::from(1) === ImmediateInt::One ? 'cold-case|' : 'BAD|';
purpose: Published enum strings and class/case arrays, generated positives, absent-method negatives, syntax-only and cold backing table.

<?php
enum QueryBacked: int { case One = 1; }
enum QueryPure { case A; }

$callee = 'is_callable';
function change_callee(): string {
    global $callee;
    $callee = 'is_int';
    echo 'REBIND|';
    return 'QueryBacked::from';
}

echo $callee(change_callee()) ? 'selected|' : 'BAD|';
echo $callee === 'is_int' ? 'rebound|' : 'BAD|';
echo ('QueryBacked::from' |> 'is_callable') ? 'pipe-yes|' : 'BAD|';
echo ('QueryPure::from' |> 'is_callable') ? 'BAD|' : 'pipe-no|';
purpose: Dynamic callee selection before argument rebinding and pipe string query of backed and pure enums.

<?php
enum NameCheck: int { case A = 1; }
$name = 'before';
$ok = is_callable('NameCheck::from', false, $name);
echo ($ok ? 'yes' : 'no'), ':', $name, '|';
purpose: The third byref output mutates a caller slot; keep it explicit Unsupported until writable-location semantics are added.

<?php
enum ShapeBound: int { case One = 1; }

echo is_callable([ShapeBound::class, 'from'], true) ? 'class-valid|' : 'BAD|';
echo is_callable([ShapeBound::One, 'from'], true) ? 'case-valid|' : 'BAD|';
echo is_callable([ShapeBound::class], true) ? 'BAD|' : 'class-short|';
echo is_callable([ShapeBound::One], true) ? 'BAD|' : 'case-short|';
echo is_callable([ShapeBound::class, 'from', 'extra'], true) ? 'BAD|' : 'class-long|';
echo is_callable([ShapeBound::class, 1], true) ? 'BAD|' : 'class-method-type|';
echo is_callable([ShapeBound::One, 1], true) ? 'BAD|' : 'case-method-type|';
echo is_callable([ShapeBound::class, 'from']) ? 'class-runtime|' : 'BAD|';
purpose: Published enum receiver remains source-certified while malformed array length and method type fail syntax-only query.
